title: Refined threshold cutoff
statement: For real numbers $\tau$, $\epsilon$, and $p_c$, let $C(\tau)$ denote the refined threshold constant at $\tau$. Define the refined threshold cutoff to be $C(\tau)\,\epsilon^{1+\tau}p_c$.
caveat: The provided statement uses the refined threshold constant but does not include its definition, so its value cannot be specified from the supplied information.
